scenes.title: The 4 Core Analytical Pillars: DOUBLE & TRIPLE TOPS/BOTTOMS, SAUCERS & V-REVERSALS

beats.hindi_tts: Pillar one: 1. Double Tops & Bottoms (M & W Patterns). Features two prominent peaks or troughs at roughly the same price level; completed ONLY upon a decisive close beyond the intervening reaction pivot.

cards.title: 1. Double Tops & Bottoms (M & W Patterns)
cards.desc: Features two prominent peaks or troughs at roughly the same price level; completed ONLY upon a decisive close beyond the intervening reaction pivot.

cards.title: 2. Triple Tops and Bottoms
cards.desc: A hybrid variation where three distinct peaks or troughs test a key barrier; volume diminishes on each successive peak, signaling exhaustion.

cards.title: 3. Saucers and Rounding Turns
cards.desc: A gradual, gentle bowl-shaped transition where price and volume curve upward together in tandem from distribution to accumulation.

cards.title: 4. V-Reversals and Island Clusters
cards.desc: Sudden, violent trend reversals triggered by abrupt surprises or panic selling, often featuring exhaustion gaps and breakaway reversal gaps.

beats.hindi_tts: First: 1. A Double Top or Bottom is never complete until prices close decisively beyond the intervening reaction pivot..

steps: 1. A Double Top or Bottom is never complete until prices close decisively beyond the intervening reaction pivot.
2. In a Double Top, the second peak must show noticeably lighter volume than the first peak.
3. In a Double Bottom, the breakout above the intervening peak must be accompanied by heavy volume expansion.
4. Minimum measuring objective: vertical height from peak to trough projected from the breakout point.
5. Triple Tops and Bottoms are completed only when support or resistance across both intervening pivots is broken.
6. Rounding/Saucer bottoms require volume to mirror the bowl shape of price, expanding on the right side.
7. V-reversals are marked by high volatility, runaway gaps, and an absence of horizontal base building.
8. If a Double Top retest rallies above the two peaks, the reversal pattern is instantly invalidated.
